instruction: Visit babycenter.com and open the detail page for the name Olivia.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to navigate to the Olivia name detail page on babycenter.com. Uses regex pattern matching to verify successful navigation to the correct page. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'babycenter.com/baby-names/details/olivia-' which is the standard format for name detail pages on this site.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing Chrome getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and existing metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match). No new functions needed. Pattern matches the babycenter.com URL structure for name detail pages.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: The instruction requires navigating to the Olivia name detail page on babycenter.com, and the evaluator verifies exactly this by checking the active tab URL.
Correct getter logic: get_active_url_from_accessTree (chrome.py:710-778) correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree and returns it as a string.
Correct metric logic: is_expected_url_pattern_match (chrome.py:70-99) correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL to verify navigation to the expected page.
Semantically correct expected value: The regex pattern 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/olivia-' accurately matches the babycenter.com URL structure for Olivia's name detail page.
Proper data flow: URL extracted by getter → pattern matching by metric → returns 1.0 if URL matches pattern (successful navigation), 0.0 otherwise.
